label: Rational authorship and epistemic ends in contingent creation
summary: Philosophical checkpoint at main 8083301a037428574d0e46b1064d8f6d858da377. Reuses #742 base-fixed net selection, #545/#555 necessitation and reason-closure boundaries, #1875 necessary bearer/contingent output and omission controls, #1380 knowledge discrimination, #737 and #1410 veracity boundaries. Distinguishes productive actual explanation, partial contrastive reasons and exhaustive determining reasons at the same whole-order explanandum. Practical authorship candidate: apprehended end, adoption for an actual reason, and intention-directed production distinguish purposive realization from post-hoc labeling and controlled lottery policy without necessarily explaining the exact endorsement contrast. Counterexample to treating the personal label as sufficient: an uncontrolled random selector within a reason-constrained policy. The same productive standard credits an impersonal producer; its modal/causal stability is compatible with reliable evidence. Normative candidate: deliberate systematic frustration of a conferred truth-directed epistemic capacity, without overriding justification, is contrary to faithfully realizing that specific end. Requires domain, normal use, genuine cognition and goodness; assertion truthfulness is not a trace-reliability theorem. No modal collapse or skepticism inferred from mere source contingency, and no actual divine application established. C2 concerns absence of n, not absence of distinct created effects. Note: docs/notes/optimal-creation-choice.md#rational-authorship-versus-brute-selection-2026-11-23. No new theorem, statement, definition, sourced claim, or support edge. Existing full-synthesis underdetermination retained; Review and repairs are recorded in PR-1911. Continuation (same date, proposed): docs/notes/optimal-creation-choice.md#can-direct-intentional-production-be-extrinsic-without-becoming-brute-2026-11-23. Read ST I q.19 a.5 and q.45 a.3/q.13 a.7 alongside q.14 a.8–9,11 and the prior #462 O'Connor/Huneeus comparison. Distinguish one-act rational order of willed means and ends from the causing of a separate act of willing. Test coarse intention versus content-specific production and merely permitted consequences. Rejected shortcut: success-defined productive relation entails the effect trivially, which does not demonstrate nontrivial efficacy of a specific intention. Compare A: a particular agent-directed productive transaction, not a separately caused executive state; B: specific content-adoption with independently intelligible intentional object and an explanatory role prior to realization, not an outcome-copying label. A can conditionally cover concrete existential dependence without settling the fact-level transaction's obtaining; B needs an account of contingent nonintrinsic adoption consistent with strict simplicity. The strong intrinsic difference principle is an additional premise, not entailed by the weak difference of the whole transaction or by absence of passive change. Productive self-knowledge needs actual direction/reference, not mere possibility knowledge or causal scope. Conditional no-mediator regress applies only to recursively demanded separate voluntary mediators; no proof of metaphysical possibility or full agency. The earlier underdetermination judgment remains; no new source binding or formal edge. Further continuation §§11–14: docs/notes/optimal-creation-choice.md#exemplar-as-practical-measure-can-specificity-belong-to-the-exercise-2026-11-23. ST I q.15 a.1–3 and q.14 a.8–9,15–16 give a positive distinction between the one cognitive principle and multiple understood exemplars, and between possible content and actually practical knowledge. SEP Action §4/Intention (secondary orientation) motivates practical measure rather than a separately caused executive event. Distinguish fixed intelligible content from variable operative role; test an intended equilateral triangle, lottery-selected triangle and misexecuted scalene intention with identical actual result. This is not a same-intrinsic-state model. A determinate specification has fulfillment conditions independently of the actual product; a world-label or successful output cannot establish its actual normative role. A nonintrinsically individuated productive exercise for a recognized exemplar is a positive hypothesis, not an implication of q.15. Exact disputed intrinsic-role supervenience versus a genuine same-intrinsic-actuality alternative pair with varying operative content. Same-source application to #1459 recipient-directed existence-willing and #1380 practical self-knowledge remains conditional. No new formal result or attributed claim; prior underdetermination retained. Further continuation §§15–18: docs/notes/optimal-creation-choice.md#active-power-immanent-operation-and-the-essential-object-of-an-act-2026-11-23. Aristotle Physics III.3 locates the shared motion in the movable (reuse existing typed readings); this does not establish no intrinsic changes in the mover. Aquinas De potentia q.1 a.1, q.3 a.15 fourth argument/ad 14–20, q.7 a.10 and ST I q.25/q.45 distinguish active principle from passive actualization, explicitly reject a transitive intermediary divine operation, and distinguish necessary immanent actuality from contingent effects. Grant–Spencer (2015), pp.12–15,40–42,53–56, distinguishes divine-act identity from essentiality of its secondary object. Reuse #555: identity/BeingCarriesAct plus secondary-object essentiality and strict content-specific efficacy would exclude an actual distinct effect's contingency; locating the effect in the patient does not by itself escape. Positive restricted-essentiality rationale: nonreceptive cognition and finite manifestations do not exhaust the divine primary good; no inference from nonexhaustion to multiple metaphysically possible choices without policy/possibility premises. Thin productive dependence plus exemplar conformity does not distinguish a coarse or blind policy from operative D-specific willing. A genuine directed exercise could be relationally individuated without a distinct intrinsic executive state, but its actual intentional-role and fact-level adequacy bridges are OPEN. Conditional textual preference for one immanent principle over a transitive intermediary, continued suspension about joint metaphysical applicability. Reuse #1731 IntentionalExemplarExtension, #1459 and #1380 without importing their open bridges. No new source claim or formal result. Further continuation §§19–22: docs/notes/optimal-creation-choice.md#restricted-object-essentiality-the-two-relations-and-particularity-of-the-recipient-2026-11-23. Newly read De veritate q.23 a.4 co./ad 2–3,6–8,11–16 (Latin [56440–56441] and English) and a.5 co./ad 1–3: Aquinas explicitly distinguishes the non-absolutely-necessary relation to the object as willed and the efficacy conditional; the productive respect presupposes the former in the order of understanding, without a contingent intermediary. This gives direct textual support for the proposed §8B architecture, not a metaphysical proof of nonintrinsic actual adoption. Expressive versus acquisitive end: a creature need not complete the source's good, but an essential rational policy could still require a unique realization; nonexhaustion or equally noble individual alternatives do not establish whole-order alternatives. New distributive-intention test: two deliberately produced cup gifts can each be intentionally made under a genuinely adopted recipient/production role without a pre-existing singular referent or separate intrinsic token for each. Actual individualized effect and nondeviant realization, not common ultimate giver or output-defined coverage, are required (reuse merged #1912 identity distinction). The same adopted role can be fulfilled by a different eligible product. Actual intentional production under that role leaves prior rigid-effect selection, #555 strict efficacy for that effect, and #1459 recipient-directed aboutness open. Maintain suspension about the actual nonintrinsic-adoption bridge, and parity for impersonal productive accounts. No new registered proof or sourced claim. Continuation §§23–30 (2026-11-24; baseline a55e21b51aae73115c95a998e32b4a6686eaa968): docs/notes/optimal-creation-choice.md#actual-direction-by-an-invariant-good-1953-2026-11-24. The third argument of ST I q.19 a.4 co./ad 4 supplies the strongest formative rationale: effects proceed through their actual mode of precontainment in the cause. Distinguish substitution of the same causal subject under esse/understanding identity from production in virtue of apprehended content D. Ordinary practical agency gives direct defeasible warrant for the latter relation; an actual-intellect, causal-form and direct-exercise account gives substantive cumulative warrant for active exemplarity at the proposed simple source. It requires no separate selecting event or regress of independently proved adoptions. Actual intellect and one power alone do not establish the formative relevance of the understood content. The equally selective impersonal producer retains the same existential-supply and primitive-exercise credit; a cognitive-but-nonoperative construction challenges the inference without certifying a full simple-source countermodel. A genuinely adopted invariant recipient role can explain intentional realization without selecting every rigid detail, while conditional permission does not initiate and necessarily efficacious categorical production excludes omission. Reuse q.14, q.19 a.2–3,5, q.45 a.3 and q.13 a.7, Aristotle NE VI.2, De anima III.9–10 and Metaphysics Theta.5 at their stated scopes. External pending #1957 in PR-1961 retains same-relation identity transfer while distinguishing relation-fact from source existence. Exact root connections: 608a262d with BX1/BX2 through 7bf9cb77 to B2; merged #1944 consumer 834ddcfa with its complete four-premise bundle to will 66aecdd7. No new support edge, formal result, pinned attribution or discharge of same-source/C2 obligations. Overall actual classical-creation application remains underdetermined; the positive interpretation and precise reopening condition supersede the generic practical-adoption test in this scope. Independent final review and publication remain pending at this local checkpoint.
blocker: OPEN, current operative-purpose scope (§§23–30): warrant that this same simple necessary source produces through its apprehended content as the actual formative principle, rather than representing the content while producing through a noncognitive selective character. Identity, one power and output conformity alone do not settle that explanatory relevance. Positive direct or cumulative warrant is admissible; no additional executive event or independent-proof regress is required. Reopen with a defended productive-principle/composition account that excludes the cognitive-but-nonoperative alternative, or with a positively warranted realization of that rival under the same source, recipient, actual supply and strict simplicity. Retain PSR domain/BX1/BX2, C2 same-bearer necessity, #1459 recipient-good, #1380 reference and #555 rigid-effect efficacy conditions. Earlier epistemic-end, overriding-reason and evidence-access questions remain open outside this scoped continuation; no premise discharge or full-synthesis resolution is claimed.

current_assessment.scope: Actual practical direction by an invariant apprehended good at the same proposed simple necessary source (#1953, §§23–30). Assess the q.19 a.4 formative-precontainment argument against good-sensitive impersonal production and cognition without formative governance. This is not a replacement assessment of every selected-effect, PSR, will or epistemic-end route.
current_assessment.assessment: Actual intellectual formation has direct defeasible warrant in ordinary agency and a substantive cumulative constitutive interpretation at an independently warranted intellectual source. Apprehension, appetite and execution need not be separate events. Source/understanding identity permits substitution of the causal subject, but does not alone establish production in virtue of apprehended D; active exemplar relevance does the additional work. Equal target coverage does not erase that explanatory difference or establish its instantiation. The impersonal rival retains equal productive and primitive-exercise credit; the cognitive-but-nonoperative challenge is not a certified simple-source countermodel. Actual ultimate application and the overall classical-creation synthesis remain underdetermined. No formal premise is discharged.
current_assessment.next_test: Give positive same-source evidence that the apprehended form is the actual productive principle. Test whether a blind selective character in that principle requires a genuinely distinct constituent under a defended composition criterion, or positively justify a one-power rival with actual cognition and noncognitive production. Preserve recipient, actual supply and strict simplicity. Further output tables or repetition of the practical/speculative distinction do not decide this question.
